scripts.build: npm run build -w vue-sentinel-x-core && npm run build -w vue-sentinel-x-runtime && npm run build -w vue-sentinel-x-vite-plugin && npm run build -w vue-sentinel-x
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w vue-sentinel-x-core && npm run typecheck -w vue-sentinel-x-core && npm run typecheck -w vue-sentinel-x-runtime && npm run typecheck -w vue-sentinel-x-vite-plugin && npm run typecheck -w vue-sentinel-x && npm run typecheck -w vue-sentinel-x-dashboard
scripts.publish:all: npm publish -w vue-sentinel-x-core --access public && npm publish -w vue-sentinel-x-runtime --access public && npm publish -w vue-sentinel-x-vite-plugin --access public && npm publish -w vue-sentinel-x --access public
